### Phase A: 等待 aria2c 完成（限 8 次轮询）

```bash
source /etc/network_turbo && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && ls -lh /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/checkpoints/openvla-7b/model-00001-of-00003.safetensors 2>/dev/null && pgrep -a aria2c && echo "DOWNLOADING" || echo "ARIA2C_DONE"
```

```bash
"
```

```bash

from transformers import AutoProcessor
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
proc = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/checkpoints/openvla-7b', trust_remote_code=True)
img = Image.fromarray(np.zeros((128,128,3), dtype=np.uint8))
inputs = proc('What action should the robot take to pick up the red block?', img, return_tensors='pt')
for k,v in inputs.items():
    print(f'{k}: shape={v.shape if hasattr(v, \"shape\") else type(v)}')

print(f'Unique tokens: {len(c)}')
print(f'Most common (top 5): {c.most_common(5)}')
"
```
